geometry.name: metagrating
geometry.description: 2D beam-deflecting metagrating: silicon ridges on a SiO2 half-space, one period, out-of-plane E (Ez), normal incidence from the substrate.
notes: Derived for G7-04 from examples/meep_comparison/metagrating/geometry.json at mesh 0.02 um: 100 x 182 cells (cell size / mesh), 20 absorber cells on each y face (0.4 um), 12000 steps of the base Courant number 0.700036 (the base physical time). Source and DFT lines keep their positions in um.

Ez nodes: TorchFDTD at -L/2 + i*h, Meep at integer multiples of h from the cell centre; the two sets coincide on an axis with an even cell count and lie half a cell apart on an axis with an odd count.

TorchFDTD: Region.pml_cells is capped at 50, so the absorber is set per face with BoundaryFace(kind='pml', layers=20) on y_min and y_max (no package change); Meep: PML of pml_cells * mesh_um = 0.4 um in y.
Smoothed series: no shift; Meep subpixel averaging (eps_averaging=True), TorchFDTD experimental subpixel interfaces.

g7_04.rule: staircase: the whole structure (ridges and substrate top) moves by half a cell in +x and +y when a material edge lies on an Ez node of TorchFDTD or Meep; source and DFT lines stay; smoothed: no shift

grid.boundary: CPML, cubic sigma profile sigma=40*rho^3/(L+1) in Courant units, kappa=1, alpha=1e-8

subpixel.epsilon_image: Reciprocal diagonal of the global inverse constitutive operator. Off-diagonal terms also act on fields.

timing.cost: full_seconds: Simulation(project).run() wall time of one grating solve (setup and stepping), CUDA-synchronised; the bare-substrate reference run is recorded separately and not counted

host.note: shared workstation: GPU jobs of other agents take turns through D:/TorchFDTD/.local/gpu_lock.py, which this run held; CPU jobs of other sessions may run concurrently; the Windows host CPU load is sampled before every run and recorded, and with max_host_cpu_percent every run waits until the load is below it (at most max_wait_seconds)
